terminals.name: server
terminals.description: Novel Engine serving the Studio SPA and JSON API on http://127.0.0.1:8000 (development, mock AI provider). Rebuild with `pnpm --dir server build` (and `pnpm --dir frontend build` for SPA changes), then restart this terminal.
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null; APP_ENVIRONMENT=development node server/dist/apps/cli/main.js serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
